title: Manipulation: the fly connectome solves every task template
note: Frozen complete MaleCNS; trained sensory encoder and linear decoder; skill-level DAgger, then PPO with DAPG that also trains the encoder (clipped); no motor-phase cue. One successful iid test episode per template.

title: Kitchen: the fly connectome completes all four tasks in every episode
note: Frozen complete MaleCNS with trained linear input and output maps; imitation, then PPO with a demonstration term (DAPG), a bonus paid in the demonstrations' order and potential-based task shaping. Official FrankaKitchen environment, 50 test episodes per condition: 100.0 from the benchmark start, from 0.2 rad and from 0.3 rad perturbed starts (all four tasks in 50 of 50 each). Shown: four episodes from 0.3 rad starts, never trained on.

title: Kitchen motion quality: before and after
note: Same 0.2 rad perturbed start, official environment. Left: the four-task controller of E49. Right: after PPO with depth, disturbance, collision, action and smoothness terms, half of each bonus held for the strict 0.1 threshold, and demonstration resets (E50 to E53). Saturated commands 46% to 2%; microwave 0.09 to 0.00, slide cabinet 0.23 to 0.07; the kettle stays at 0.23.
